dogecoin.text: I was wearing a #dogecoin shirt at the airport recently, and a dude laughed and said, “it’s going to zero”...all I said was, we will see...now it’s at 13 cents and climbing... Some want doge to fail so bad, but they are missing out on the fun.
@dogecoin_empire $10-20 dollar range in a few years...but doge does what it wants, so it could be there or more this year.
